import { createContextKey, declareExtern, definePrototype } from '@proto.ui/core/authoring';

export const PAIR_ZONE = createContextKey<string>('pair-zone');

const loadItem = declareExtern<[id: string], string>({
  name: 'fixture.load-keyed-item',
  effect: 'after-state-commit',
  lifetime: 'task',
  async: true,
  targets: ['react', 'gpui'],
});

export default definePrototype({
  name: 'pair-reader',
  setup(def) {
    const zone = def.context.consume(PAIR_ZONE);
    const stage = def.state.define<string>('stage', { initialize: () => 'idle' });
    const readPair = def.task<[firstId: string, secondId: string], void>(
      'readPair', { policy: 'latest' }, async (task, firstId, secondId) => {
        const start = task.get(zone);
        task.set(stage, 'first@' + start);
        const first = await task.await(loadItem, firstId);

        const middle = task.get(zone);
        task.set(stage, 'second@' + start + '>' + middle + '=' + first);
        const second = await task.await(loadItem, secondId);

        task.set(stage, start + '>' + middle + '>' + task.get(zone) + '=' + first + '/' + second);
      }
    );
    const begin = def.action<[firstId: string, secondId: string], void>('begin', (run, firstId, secondId) => {
      run.start(readPair, firstId, secondId);
    });
    def.expose.action('begin', begin);
    def.expose.state('stage', stage);
    return view => view.el('span', {}, [view.get(stage)]);
  },
});
